title: Add 45 minutes of time in bed for two weeks.
subtitle: Sleep extension experiment
rationale: Test whether current sleep is quietly short by extending the window and watching performance respond.

evidence.summary: Small extension studies in athletes show faster reaction times and better performance after weeks of deliberately longer sleep; generalization is untested.

sources.label: Sleep extension and athletic performance study

indications: Sleep duration hovers at the low end of the adult range.
Daytime sleepiness persists despite consistent timing.
Caffeine dose has crept upward to compensate.
